cells.detail: ✅ — Host allow-list. Origin check on every upgrade and non-GET. Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site refused. Headers: CSP, nosniff, DENY, no-referrer, COOP, CORP. Port-scoped cookie name. Cookie sessions persist hash-only across restarts (0600, pruned on boot). — _Evidence:_ `src/Server/Http/AuthMiddleware.php:211-227`; `src/Server/Http/ApiController.php:31,133-153`; `src/Server/Auth/RateLimiter.php:14-27`; `src/Server/Auth/CookieSessions.php:16-19`

narrative.old: 8 of the 66 protocol methods are never requested from the browser (`server.shutdown` still arrives as a notification and is handled).
narrative.new: 8 of the 69 protocol methods are never requested from the browser: `files.read`, `memory.log`, `memory.undo`, `session.share`, `session.unshare`, `workflow.status`, `workspace.close`, and the Admin-scope `server.shutdown` (which arrives as a notification and is handled).

narrative.old: - `/theme`, `/keys` and `/sessions` are terminal-only (`/model`, `/compact` and `/init` gained host bodies and now run over the wire).
narrative.new: - 16 built-ins have no host body and are refused `ui_only` over the wire: `/new`, `/sessions`, `/effort`, `/exit`, `/theme`, `/settings`, `/keys`, `/help`, `/compress`, `/newrule`, `/pane`, `/layout`, `/editor`, `/budget`, `/review` and `/security-review` (`/theme`, `/settings`, `/sessions` and `/new` have web-native equivalents). The other 41 run on the server, `/model`, `/compact`, `/init`, `/goal`, `/grind`, `/btw`, `/hooks` and `/skills` among them.

narrative.old: - No panel shows loaded instructions, skills, MCP or hooks; only text commands (`/context`, `/mcp`, `/notices`) hint at them.
narrative.new: - The Context panel (`context.sources`) lists loaded instruction files (path, size, tier), refused files, memory notes, skills (name and tier) and project MCP servers (configured status, no liveness), with a project-trust prompt; hooks show only through the server-run `/hooks` text table. `@mcp:` mentions, MCP prompt commands, `/mcp login` and `/skill-name` do not work in served sessions, and runtime notices (memory recall, model fallback) never reach the browser because serve does not drain the notice sink.

narrative.old: - No P1 remains: background sessions inherit the server's permission mode and route their asks to the approvals drawer.
narrative.new: - Background sessions inherit the server's permission mode and route their asks to the approvals drawer; a `/loop` typed in the browser registers but never fires (the served host has no ephemeral-schedule pump).

narrative.new: webhook triggers are serve-only (no outbound); share links need a running `serve` (no hosted endpoint); `/loop` never fires in a served session

narrative.new:
- `PtyRun` is inside the permission model: its steps are rule/classifier/breaker/grant subjects, render in the modal, drive shell hooks and honour the bwrap sandbox.
  - Edit/Write/ApplyPatch approvals preview the diff and show full arguments, with `v` to expand.
